title: soapff: atom typing and force-field distribution with reference structures
description: soapff gives every atom of a structure the type and charge of the most similar atom of typed reference structures (SOAP of the atoms within 4 bonds), from the elements and coordinates only, and writes the LAMMPS force field. Bundled libraries: ClayFF (layered clay minerals, water and ions), a ClayFF-based model of a montmorillonite particle with edges, OPLS-AA (polymers), TIP3P and SPC/E with ions. The examples hold the test structures, scripts and results of the paper.
